reviews.text: I have been coming here for over 10 years now with 4 pets. I wouldn’t go anywhere else.
The office is very clean. Friendly staff. Our tech was so sweet and really listened and documented everything. The doctor was nice as well.

South Kendall has been caring for my dog and cat for the past eight years and I am pleased with their services. They’re caring, compassionate, professional and personable.  I highly recommend this facility.

Had a great experience After long search for a new vet that actually know what they’re doing for our fur baby Gracie we came across South Kendall Animal Hospital & it was the best decision ever & worth the drive, everyone from Dr. Lantigue, Alysia, Receptionist & Beth where super friendly & super knowledgeable with cats, we felt super comfortable & was treated like family. I have been going to south kendall animal hospital for years! They are courteous and invested in your pet's health! Highly recommend!

What an extraordinary Vet Office!  I have never encountered a more caring and professional veterinary staff.  They took great care of my goldendoodle Einstein, performing what turned out to be a very difficult surgery.  They stayed well beyond closing time to complete the procedure and kept me informed appropriately during the process.  Highly recommended!

We were in somewhat of an emergency situation and needed our dog's medication refilled (his regular vet is in Georgia).  I called them in the morning and they got us in by that afternoon to see him and prescribe his medication.  Definitely the vet we will be using during the times we spend in Miami...highly recommend.  Very professional, caring and took the time to go over everything in detail with us.
I have been using South Kendall Animal Hospital since 1984, 38 years!  They are the best.  I wouldn't think of taking my four legged loved ones any place else.

I cannot say enough wonderful things about South Kendall Animal Hospital. Every single person there treated Becky with such genuine love and compassion. From Dr. Berruecos, who called to check in on Becky when we were out of the country and stayed connected with us over the phone during a very difficult time, to every staff member who greeted us and cared for her, you could truly feel that everything they did came from the heart.

They always treated Becky as if she were their own. Over the years they helped us with so much paperwork whenever we traveled with her, and they were always patient, kind, and incredibly helpful through the process. Whenever Becky was sick and we brought her in, they treated her with so much care and always reassured us, which meant so much as pet parents.

The team helped guide us through Becky’s final years with compassion and support, and for that I will be eternally grateful. After Becky passed, they sent us a card that truly brought us to tears and showed just how much they care about the animals and families they serve.

De. Weir and the entire staff are great and treat all patients with great care.

I recently took my dog in for what we thought was an abscess. After thoroughly examining her and performing tests under microscope, it was concluded not an abscess but the result of the groomer nicking the affected area that caused an inflammatory reaction (my dog went to the groomer the day prior). I am so grateful for the detailed care, and attention my dog received. They are thorough and professional. It was also extremely helpful they carried the medication my dog needed in stock and off we went.
Hello Melissa, Thank you for taking the time to rate us!

The absolute best place to take your pet. From the moment you walk in, you feel the love, care, and family-friendly atmosphere. The entire staff and doctors are beyond amazing and treat both pets and owners with so much kindness and compassion. Dr. Berruecos is truly exceptional—the best doctor, with a heart of gold. You can feel that your pet is genuinely cared for like family. I would recommend this place 100% to anyone who loves their pets as much as family.

We had been clients at another animal hospital for over 37 years.  However, when the practice was sold (the vet retired), the quality of the care and office staff deteriorated.  It was a constant struggle to get prescriptions filled, a completely new staff every time we visited, and not pleased with one of the new vets.
I was at the pharmacy telling the pharmacist when another customer overheard the conversation.  She asked what the name of the hospital was, and when I told her, she agreed that they have been losing clients en masse.  Since her husband is a vet tech, I asked her where she took her pets for care and she highly recommended South Kendall Animal Hospital.
I checked this practice out online and was very pleased to see that it is an all-female owned practice and all three vets have incredible credentials.
I was pleasantly shocked when I called for a "meet and greet" appointment for Fiona (our 10 year-old rescue) that I wasn't placed on hold, rather, a very helpful and pleasant person made the appointment.
When we arrived, it was adorable to see that the names of all the pets who had appointments today were welcomed on a giant blackboard.  While I was waiting, I spoke with another client waiting to pick up her dogs.  She said that she had been a client there for almost 20 years and had nothing but great things to say about the practice.
When Fiona and I were taken to the exam room, she was terrified because it was a new set of surroundings (she has anxiety issues anyway ).  The nurse came in and reviewed Fiona's history that I had sent ahead through the website.  She was very thorough and spoke very softly and sweetly to Fiona to help put her at ease.
A few minutes later, the nurse returned with Dr. Berruecos.  Rather than put Fiona through MORE stress, they sat on the floor at eye level.  While the doctor examined Fiona, the nurse soothed her by petting her, giving her small treats and massaging her muscles.  Fiona's tail did NOT stop wagging!
The general exam was thorough and Dr. Berruecos showed me a few molars where plaque had started to develop and recommended a cleaning (which we were aware of).
All in all, it was a great experience and the difference from the old practice that we left was "night and day".  The entire staff at this hospital are pleasant, professional, and very loving towards all of their animal clients.
I look forward to a long relationship with this animal hospital and the vets for Fiona and any future dogs we may have! :)
UPDATE 01/02/26:  Fiona had her annual exam at the new offices.  Again, an outstanding experience with a caring staff and doctors who truly love animals and make every effort to make them less stressed and more comfortable during an exam.  I am so pleased with this animal hospital and the staff that runs it!

I want to share my experience, in case it can help others avoid what we're going through. Yesterday, June 17, 2025, I took my dog ​​to South Kendall Animal for a dental cleaning, and after waiting all day for him, they told me his heart had stopped and they couldn't do anything.

My dog ​​was healthy. He had his lab work done a week before, he had just turned eight, and he was doing great. I never imagined something like this could happen. Now they say the only thing they can think of is that he had some kind of heart problem, but they don't understand.

It doesn't matter anymore... nothing will bring him back, and I don't know how to console my children, ages 13 and 11, and my family for the pain they're feeling. I'm just sharing this so you'll be very careful with your dogs.

It's very hard to trust people to care for your furry family as you would, so having a place you feel you can safely ask for furry help is such an incredible resource. I called today to make an appointment for my pup who really needed some help, expecting an appointment next week, and they were able to get me in before the end of the day. My pup gets nervous in waiting rooms (and I needed to charge my phone), and Erica came out to my car to ask some questions so he wouldn't be stressed out preemptively. The whole visit, all the women in office were so helpful, kind, and patient with me and my pup, sitting on the floor to make him comfortable and finding ways to check him out without stressing him unnecessarily. Dr. Berruecos, who was seeing us this visit, even left and came back with another doctor (Dr. Weil?) to get a second opinion on something - I can't tell you how much I appreciated this. Humility in the workplace is rare, and for her to simply ask another doctor for her opinion showed me she cared about the well being of my pet, more than ego or pride, enough to ask for outside advice. Together, they put their expertise and knowledge together and gave me honest recommendations about my steps for my pups health - being honest but kind about a less than ideal situation. They were both very professional and kind, and I am grateful to them for the experience.

I want to specifically call out Erica, who was the vet tech helping me today. From coming out to my car to speak, to her 'bedside manner' in the exam room, Erica was patient, helpful, and easy going through the whole experience. She became an unexpected anchor for me later in the appointment, when I got emotional, and she showed me such kindness that she had no obligation to give me but that I desperately needed. On top of all that, she's funny and a ray of sunshine, and I've never had a tech interact with my furry boy in such a patient way. Everyone made this visit the best it could be in the circumstances, but Erica made it feel personal and empathetic in a place that very much needs such things, and I won't forget her kindness. Thank you very much Erica, Dr. Berruecos, Dr. Weil, and everyone else who helped Troy and I today.
